title: ExtractedDocumentData
description: Structured entities, dates, and relationships extracted from a source document (PDF or web page).

entities.description: Named things mentioned in the document (people, organizations, locations, etc.).

name.description: The entity's name as it appears in the document.

description.description: A short note on who/what this entity is or how it's relevant, based only on the document.

dates.description: Dates mentioned in the document and what they refer to.

date.description: ISO 8601 (YYYY-MM-DD) if the date can be fully resolved; otherwise the raw text as it appeared in the document (e.g. 'March 2024', 'last Thursday').

description.description: What this date refers to (e.g. 'founding of the company', 'contract signing').

relationships.description: Relationships between entities, as subject-predicate-object triples.

subject.description: The entity the relationship starts from. Should match an entity name in the entities list.

predicate.description: The relationship itself, as a short verb phrase (e.g. 'works for', 'acquired', 'located in').

object.description: The entity the relationship points to. Should match an entity name in the entities list.
